simulator.note: 5 identical byte-for-byte stdout runs; see docs/METHODOLOGY.md SS5 'the oracle is not exempt'.

models_used.note: Vendor-provenance behavioural port; declares no timing model.

R25=100k, B=4190K sourced read-only from elec/src/modules.ato CoilThermalComparator's inline comment (same NTCALUG01A104GA part family as the heatsink sensor). No Steinhart-Hart table for this part is committed anywhere in this repo. 'Temperature' is an idealized ramped proxy signal, not a thermal-mass or thermal-time-constant simulation.

implementation_scope.note: THM-02 previously had NO implementing circuit at all (docs/hardware/PROTECTION_CHAIN_REVIEW.md: 'OCP-02, THM-02 -- no circuit exists'). This is the first simulation of THM-02.

verdict.sensor_rating_caveat: NTCALUG01A104GA is specified to +125C; the simulated trip temperature (120.0C) is within 5.0C of that rated maximum. Flagged per the module's own comment, not resolved by this harness.
verdict.response_time_reason: TLV3201_ngspice.lib declares no timing model; the ramped 'temperature' driver is an idealized proxy, not a thermal time-constant simulation.
verdict.summary: Simulated THM-02 (coil NTC) trip temperature is 119.95 degC and recovery temperature is 100.13 degC (uncalibrated), giving 19.82 degC of hysteresis. This is WITHIN the THM-02 120C trip / 100C recovery requirement (FUNCTIONAL_TEST_CRITERIA.md SS2.3), matching CoilThermalComparator's own inline hand-derivation (120.0C trip, 100.1C recovery) to within 0.05 degC / 0.03 degC. The trip point sits 5.0 degC below the NTC's own +125C rated maximum -- close enough that the module itself flags it as a caveat.
